review:
Candy Blitz is a 6x5 pay-anywhere candy slot where eight or more matching sweets anywhere on the board win. Winning symbols disappear and cascade, potentially chaining wins together from a single spin.

The key feature is a multiplier reel at the side of the grid, which can boost wins by up to 500x. Four or more scatters trigger free spins, where the minimum multiplier rises to 2x, and four more scatters retrigger the round. Pragmatic Play advertises a 10,000x maximum. The RTP is 96.08%. If you enjoy Sweet Bonanza but want the multiplier displayed separately and more clearly, this is a natural alternative.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
